result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and basic sidewalk infrastructure on a signalized urban street. However, the lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals and the presence of parked vehicles near the crossing point create potential safety gaps for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A white van parked close to the crosswalk on the left side may obstruct the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, immediately adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Unprotected Wide Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island or curb extensions to reduce exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and signalized traffic control within a residential row-house context. However, the wide street width and presence of parked vehicles near the crossing points may limit visibility and increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the image are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes (travel and parking) without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and signalized control, providing basic infrastructure for crossing. However, the lack of curb extensions and the presence of parked cars near the intersection create sightline issues and longer crossing distances.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the crosswalk obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street approaching the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Tactile Warnings
hazards.description: Curb ramps lack truncated domes or tactile warning surfaces for visually impaired pedestrians.

hazards.name: Road Debris
hazards.description: Litter and debris are scattered in the roadway and near the gutter, potentially causing slips.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile warning pads on all curb ramps to improve accessibility.
